notes.title: Christmas repairs
notes.content:
Modification to the features of the multiplayer mode, repairing several lobby components. New version of the timer to ensure synchronization between players.
New spectator system, applied for competitive events.

Main menu adjustment, to avoid confusion on the part of players when choosing the mode. Now the play button displays the story mode option and the garka games (competitions).

Repair and adjustment of story mode features, within Level 5 where lighting and other game functions were optimized where we detected errors in the behavior of objects.

notes.title: Multiplayer update
notes.content: fixed several bugs related to lobby, gameplay and final score.

notes.title: The Joystick arrived
notes.content:
By popular request, we have added the ability to play with the Joystick, improving the gaming experience, but maintaining some functions and interface that require the use of a mouse (for now).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed several UI details and cinematics that did not disappear when they should.
[*] Tier 3 system fix: sliding band trap destroyed the player instead of taking life points, now fixed.
[*] Correction in the opening speed of one of the doors on level 3
[*] Review and correction of details in game cinematics.
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]

[list]
[*] We improved the quality of textures of several icons and characters, so that they will not load blurry
[*] Creation of LOD to reduce the polygons of trampolines and game platforms, which affected game performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Let's go with everything!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/57cd49fc23f8f30cd990ee2d986eee294afc3019.jpg[/img]

It is with great pleasure that we present the complete game, with a total of 12 levels dedicated to the fun achieved from action and comedy combined. Below we present the new features of this update:

Story mode: we have reviewed the game levels and polished several details and imperfections detected, such as map borders, sub-level loading optimization, even actor and route optimization.

More obstacles: we added turrets to several game levels, making it more difficult and helping you as a player to stay in constant movement.

Boss Code Improvement: We revised the boss behavior code and improved the reaction to damage.

Texture Optimization: We improve game performance by optimizing the resolution of textures based on their function.

We reorganized the main menu so that the tutorial is now available without having to start a new game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/fca7c8ea8a646d1c7826609497b29f95da0efcff.png[/img]

[b]What's new: Competitive mode[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/65c330b5b6955d09f169903c9ab2daee53dee740.png[/img]

We bring you a new mode dedicated to promoting competition between players, a game mode that we have divided into two instances: individual and multiplayer.

In the individual competitive mode you will be challenged to hit targets within a certain time, receiving points based on the accuracy of the hit, the number of coins collected and enemies defeated. 

In competitive multiplayer mode you face others in a scenario dedicated to the race to obtain more points. On this map you will have to collect points based on the amount of coins collected and enemies defeated.

We appreciate the wait and wish you a good gaming experience.

notes.title: Game on
notes.content: Ready to start with the Garka Games. May the best player wins!!

notes.title: Garka Games are here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/756b6befa2e8e9a5f821ef459903796b5e76106a.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the new game mode known as the Garka games, a single-player competitive mode in which you must complete all the objectives and collect the greatest number of points in the shortest time possible.

notes.title: Not clear enough? No worries

Gameplay improvement for level 1: now you will get better instructions of what to do. Also, we adjusted the HP of the boss so it´s more killeable

notes.title: New Levels
notes.content:
After hard work, we are pleased to announce the arrival of two new levels for the Banaverse, which are the multiverse and Peluca's castle.

New challenges, new encounters and old enemies will be present in scenarios brought to you to be played with Bananero and Andrés.

notes.title: Steam Bana Awards 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/c648fcb923f7947910edac88ea30e3fc24e3d9a3.jpg[/img]

Dedicated to the Steam nominations, today we are putting the game on promotion so that everyone has the opportunity to get to know the Bananero and the Banaverse madness.

A game with no limits on the adventures you can experience, full of increasingly crazy characters and places.

Enjoy the first worlds and challenges that you will find in Follies in the Banaverse, playing with the Banana Man as your main character, and Andrés Di Bono, his faithful friend and companion, fighting against the impostor Santa and his army of robot cucumbers who will search make your life miserable while you try to escape their clutches.

In this first stage of the game you will find characters belonging to the banana universe, such as Santa, The gorilla, Peloconcha, Isabel, The poronga fish, Andrés and Bananero himself. Enjoy these first levels and be part of the Bana universe.

notes.title: patch June 25th
notes.content:
Fixed the challenge in level 2 where you had to collect two cranks in order to access a point that opens a gate.

The timer for that gate was removed as it was unnecessary and caused technical difficulties.

notes.title: LV3 Door fix
notes.content: Small patch to fix some doors over lv3 to lock only at a safe distance, so players wont get trap

notes.title: Notes Update June 23, 2023
notes.content:
The update considers the following changes:

[list]
[*] Automatic system to save progress: now it is possible to resume the game according to the progress of the game, with several established checkpoints.
[*]Improved stage decoration to support player orientation
[*]Revision and repair of challenge bugs, solved the puzzle of the pepigrones in the cage.
[*]Add sfx to space objects
[*] Addition of background music for Isabel and CDT
[*]Extension of levels 2 and 3, now they have a small extension to receive the special guest.
[*]"El Peluca" has arrived! find him within the levels and receive his help to advance through the follies in the Banaverse
[/list]
